messages:
sam: noticed `payments-prod` sampler dropped captures for ~5m after spike. We need a safe way to get short-term visibility.
ivy: Agree. Proposal: ops-only "diagnostic windows" that require reason + ticket and emit immutable audit. Keep windows short (5-15m).
carl: Also require preview showing estimated_pii_delta before approving. If estimate > threshold require 2FA.
audit-bot: ALERT: route=payments-prod sample_drop=0.92 threshold=0.6 at 2026-06-10T16:03:12Z
morgan: Implementation: request-logger endpoint POST /internal/routes/{r}/diagnostic {minutes,profile,ticket,reason}. Response returns before/after ledger and exposure_delta_estimate.
sam: add redaction_profile + redaction_confidence to every sampled event. If confidence < 0.7 store hashed placeholders only.
carl: console: compact CTA "Request diagnostic" -> preview modal with delta and required approvers. Show last audit entries inline.
ivy: rollout: ops-only canary -> 5 tenants -> expand. Watch metric: redaction_fail_rate and exposure_spent. If either spikes rollback.
morgan: I'll PR the API + audit sink today. Sam can add telemetry fields. Carl/Victor can mock UI (will post Figma).
